headline: Island Fronts Erupt As Stlican Shelf Flips To Warden Lead
war_summary: Island sectors have erupted into sudden motion over the past three hours, led by Fisherman's Row where nine rapid base transactions swept through Arcadia, Eidolo, and Black Well, though Colonial garrisons retain hold of all nine positions. Across the sea at Tempest Island, Reef saw four swift exchanges in the last two hours, leaving the island completely under Colonial control. On the eastern mainland, Stlican Shelf underwent a dramatic reversal: four base actions in two hours propelled Warden forces into a five-to-three lead over the Colonials, with one contested position demolished in no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse remains locked in bitter combat, logging six fresh base changes in two hours around Frostmarch and Crow's Nest while swallowing more than 2,100 casualties in an unbroken four-to-five stalemate. Severe attrition persists without territorial shifts in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County, where combined casualties topped 2,000 and 1,300 respectively over the last two hours. Meanwhile, earlier turmoil in Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow has largely subsided into steady trench warfare without further positional collapse.
